{{Quote|One of about a thousand entrepreneurs who show up in business reports and investor profiles. He leases cargo vessel berths on Ruby Habitat up in orbit.|Thaymes Fodrick on Thadley Biolan|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Ruby Habitat''' was an orbital habitat above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]]. It contained cargo vessel berths that could be leased by private individuals and businesses.<ref name="MK" />
